csv_project_name: Engineering for Citywide Active Transportation & Mobility
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Worthington is requesting proposals, including statements of interest and qualifications, from consultants to provide engineering services for their Citywide Active Transportation and Mobility Program("The Program"). The goal of the Program is to improve the connectivity, safety, and accessibility of Worthington's bicycle, pedestrian, and transit network in alignment with the City's 2019 Bicycle and PedestrianMaster Plan. The initial program term is anticipated to be three (3) years, with the option, at the City's discretion, to renew the contract for up to two (2) additional one (1) year terms for continued on-call servicesand future project phases.The Program scope includes, but is not limited to, the preparation of preliminary and detailed designs, studies, and consulting services for active transportation and mobility improvements along a collection oflocal roadway corridors. The Program includes five projects/elements, which will be bundled under one professional services contract. The projects are listed below:1. Worthington-Galena Road Corridor Study2. E. Wilson Bridge Road Shared Use Path3. Sidewalk Gap Elimination Program4. SR 315 / SR 161 Interchange & Olentangy Trail Crossing Imp.5. General On-Call Mobility and Transportation Services
csv_disciplines_requested: Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies, Transportation Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Feasibility Studies, Planning/Master Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design
